propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate managed the production launch of passkey sign-in, which went GA to every customer, including release approvals and post-launch incident handling.
propositions.rationale: The general-availability statement is attributed to the head of product, and the documented work is a beta in the preview environment whose plan lists general availability as open questions. The deployment rule forbids describing a beta in a preview environment as a production launch, and the relayed remark does not say what the candidate managed.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the passkey sign-in beta with design partners, gathering feedback through fortnightly calls and a tagged feedback board.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the feedback work, the beta plan documents the preview-environment programme and the reference check confirms the candidate ran the beta.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coordinated the security architecture review and an external penetration test of the passkey flows, closing 11 findings before the beta opened.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the review track and the findings closed.

expectedGap: Only the beta in the preview environment is documented; a production launch with release approvals, launch-day coordination and incident handling is not.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the beta, the security review track and the risk register work; record the general-availability remark as the head of product's words, not as a launch the candidate managed.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether passkey sign-in reached general availability while the candidate was at Quayline, and which release approvals, launch-day tasks and post-launch incidents the candidate handled.
